description: Dependency updates (ADR-048 'Supply chain and repository settings', WP-6 D9): grouped, weekly, three days after release, never merged without a review.

packageRules.description: Development tools, non-major updates in one pull request. Matched by name: the catalog in pnpm-workspace.yaml has no dependency type.
The Nest family, non-major updates in one pull request.
OpenTelemetry, non-major updates in one pull request.
GitHub Actions, SHA and version comment together, in one pull request. Majors stay alone. A digest update with no version change means a moved tag: review it as a warning sign.

Node in one pull request: the version in .nvmrc (nvm manager) and the base image the Dockerfiles pin in `ARG NODE_IMAGE` (dockerfile manager, tag and digest) move together, as scripts/docker-base-image.test.mjs requires.

customManagers.description: Container images run with `docker run` in the workflows and the root scripts (gitleaks and zizmor from GHCR, Trivy from Docker Hub), written as name:tag@digest. One pull request updates every file that names the image. GHCR returns no release dates, so the cooldown holds those updates on the dependency dashboard until a box there is ticked; Docker Hub images carry dates and follow the cooldown.
